subject.title: [Feature] Prune stale orphaned sessions from Dashboard Sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a destructive Dashboard orphan-session prune flow for Telegram/Discord sessions, and if so what reachability, retention, and default-age policy should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is useful, but implementing it safely requires maintainer intent on false positives, plugin-owned channel checks, transcript retention, and whether auto-prune creates persistent policy/config surface.

options.title: Approve preview-first prune design
options.body: Proceed only with an explicit preview/apply flow, plugin-owned reachability checks, final revalidation, and maintainer-approved defaults before deletion.

options.title: Split Discord first
options.body: Keep this broader item open but prioritize the narrower Discord lifecycle work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50310 before adding a combined Dashboard feature.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup only
options.body: Decline automatic or reachability-based orphan pruning for now and keep selected-row deletion plus CLI maintenance as the supported cleanup path.

recommendation.title: Approve preview-first prune design
recommendation.body: Proceed only with an explicit preview/apply flow, plugin-owned reachability checks, final revalidation, and maintainer-approved defaults before deletion.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across session management, Control UI, and the maintenance policy this product decision would change.
